translations.web: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
translations.bsb: Heaven must take Him in until the time comes for the restoration of all things, which God announced long ago through His holy prophets.
translations.kjv: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
